title: Linear extremal bounds for a family of forbidden $0$-$1$ matrices
summary: Fulek defined the $0$-$1$ matrix \[ L_3=\begin{pmatrix} 1&0&0&1&0\\ 0&0&0&0&1\\ 0&1&1&0&0 \end{pmatrix} \] and asked whether $\text{ex}(n,L_3) = O(n)$. We prove that every $r\times s$ $0$-$1$ matrix avoiding $L_3$ has at most $27r+2s$ $1$ entries. Fulek's general lower bound construction has $6n-8$ $1$ entries, so \[ 6n-8\leq \text{ex}(n,L_3)\leq29n \] for $n\geq5$. The same argument applies to an infinite family.
